Turkie men aayojit COP31 shikhar sammelan men jivashm eendhan aur Climate Finance ko lekar deshon ke bich sahamti nahin ban saki. jalvayu parivartan se nipatne ki jimmedari aur viksit deshon ki vittiy javabdehi par gahrate matbhedon ne vaishvik jalvayu sahyog ke samne naee chunautiyan khari kar di hain.
Thank you for watching our video!
